edges.rationale: Defining quality dimensions such as consistency establishes the criteria needed to ensure annotations are consistent across examples and annotators.
Quality dimensions such as validity and fitness for purpose define what constitutes extraneous, sensitive, or toxic content that should be removed during cleaning.
Annotation guidelines provide the rules that annotators must follow to ensure consistency across examples and annotators.
Annotation guidelines provide the standards against which manual inspection verifies annotation trustworthiness and identifies inconsistencies.
Cleaned and filtered data provides a safer, more focused dataset for manual inspectors to verify annotation trustworthiness and uniqueness.
